parsed.explanation: Trans-specific positives are real and documented: the 1961 'impersonating a female' offence — the actual lever once used against trans women — was repealed in 2013 and gender presentation is no longer criminal; the Sentencing Act 2016 makes gender-identity bias an aggravating factor; a long-standing third-gender tradition is described by the government in UPR as integral, with chiefly titles. The sodomy sections (5 years) are a secondary, sexuality-law factor: framed by act not identity, unenforced per the overview, no recorded prosecutions, and the local third-gender community itself deprioritised repeal — a dead letter, not a trans-facing lever. Deductions: the 'very tolerant of transgender' claim is uncorroborated and unquantified; no documented service-refusal remedy, facility/ward practice, custody placement, border/document experience, policing practice, or any trans-specific violence monitoring — all open questions, and no GI employment protection. Sits a step below the documented-remedy tier.
